description: Governor's Office - Western Province - Extending the time of the Single Person Inquiry Board
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the extension of an investigation period for an inquiry board (comprised of a retired judge) into potential offenses by a local government body and its chairman. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it pertains to a legal inquiry, investigation procedures, and the powers of a provincial governor in relation to an ordinance. It does not fit the government personnel/structure categories (Types 1-3) as it is about a specific judicial investigation process rather than government appointments or restructuring.
